text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding Turnstile14b (int4) is showing a perf & stability surprise in canary. P95 latency jumped ~30% compared to fp16 at default batch_size=16, and we had two coldstart OOMs inside the first 200 requests. Sharing quick config + logs.
ken: Which environment? hosted canary or dedicated?
maria: hosted canary. Config snapshot:
```json
{"batch_size":16, "max_new_tokens":256, "prefetch":true, "kv_eviction":"auto", "quantize":"int4-calibrated"}
```
Logs show: `slab_alloc_fail at slot=43, free_slots=0` then worker restart.
ravi: That slab/fragmentation profile screams padding mismatch for short sequences. Try batch_size=8 and enable slot_reserve (0.15) to avoid aggressive reuse. Also consider reducing `max_new_tokens` default to 128 for this model class.
aaron: +1 to smaller batch. Also check kernel selection — we had kernel=v2-matmul-int4 pick an execution path that peaks memory due to extra scratch buffers. If you force kernel=v1 it sometimes lowers transient allocs.
maria: Kicking an experiment: batch=8, max_new_tokens=128, prefer_slot_reserve=0.15, kernel=v1. Running a 1k-qps smoke now.
maria (20m): Smoke results: OOMs are gone. P95 improved but still +12% vs fp16. Throughput drop expected with smaller batch. However quality eval on the summarization eval set shows a small regression: -1.8 ROUGE-L relative.
ravi: Hmm. Could be too-aggressive quant calibration. What was the calibration mode? per_channel? hessian?
maria: calibrate=true, per_channel=true, hessian_scale=false. Will try per_channel=false and re-eval.
aaron: If quality delta stays >1% we should fallback heavy prompts to fp16 variant via routing rule. Also consider slightly increasing `soft_reserve` for prefix KV (helps long prompts).
ken: We should also add a telemetry flag to mark any canary with >1% quality regression or >10% latency regression so rollouts auto-hold. Can infra add a canary guard? @infra-bot? :eyes:
infra-bot: Deploy note — created canary split: 5% -> int4-turnstile14b (batch=8, max_new_tokens=128) at 4801239300. Telemetry hooks added for latency/quality thresholds.
maria: Thanks — I'll run full eval suite (conversational + summarization + long prompt) and open a PR with recommended defaults: batch=8, max_new_tokens=128, slot_reserve=0.15, fallback to fp16 for flagged prompts.
ken: Perfect. If the per_channel->false fix recovers quality, we can keep int4 with those defaults and record the calibration method in model-metadata.
maria: noted. will post results in ~2h and tag y'all. :thumbsup:
